name: analysis_prompt
description: Prompt for data analysis and insights generation

analysis_goal.description: Goal or objective of the analysis

template: You are a data analyst. Analyze the provided {{data_type}} data with the goal of {{analysis_goal}}. Context: {{context}}. Provide clear insights and actionable recommendations.

latest.prompt: You are a data analyst. Analyze the provided {{data_type}} data with the goal of {{analysis_goal}}. Context: {{context}}. Provide clear insights and actionable recommendations.
